tasks.title: Health 02: 57 lint errors in files changed this week (typecheck clean)
tasks.description:
## Goal (card: fix-baseline-failures-in-leonidas-code-main..., AIOS tasks)
Clear the 57 `vp lint` errors found in the 22 files that changed in the last 7 days in `leonidas-code` (apps/web and apps/server). Typecheck is clean (0 errors in apps/server and apps/web), so this is lint drift only.

## Evidence (health-02 run, 2026-11-09, main at 9d581b58bd)
Command: `vp lint <files changed in last 7 days>` in 150-file chunks. 57 errors, 454 warnings (warnings out of scope).

| Rule | Errors | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| t3code(no-native-title-tooltip) | 26 | apps/web/src/components/systemCare/PcInsights.tsx:144, LibraryWindow.tsx:95, SidebarChrome.tsx:65 |
| t3code(namespace-node-imports) | 11 | apps/server/src/subagents/{subagentSpecV1,subagentPersona,spawnTiers}.test.ts:2-3 |
| shadcn(no-restyle) | 7 | UsageOverlayCard.tsx:968, DraftHeroHeadline.tsx:311 |
| shadcn(no-arbitrary-values) | 6 | SystemCareCharts.tsx:203,268,308 (use text-2xs / text-3xs) |
| t3code(no-global-process-runtime) | 3 | LocalModelsService.ts:143, GitVcsDriverCore.test.ts:1302,1745 |
| t3code(require-suppression-reason) | 1 | PcInsights.tsx:330 |
| t3code(prefer-catch-tags) | 1 | OrchestratorMcpService.ts:2132 |
| t3code(no-test-in-loop) | 1 | ClaudeAdapterV2.test.ts:3170 |
| unused oxlint-disable | 1 | ModelPickerContent.tsx:213 |

## Why not a safe fix
57 errors across 22 files, over the 30-line limit. Tooltip and restyle fixes change visible behavior (Tooltip component, Button variants) and need a design check.

## Acceptance checks
- `vp lint` on the 22 files reports 0 errors.
- `vp run typecheck` in apps/server and apps/web stays at 0 errors.
- Scoped tests for touched files pass. Run the performance-gate skill.
- Do not weaken lint rules. Do not use blanket suppressions.

Fix choice: delete the 40 comments, or port the upstream rule into the plugin.

tasks.title: Web typecheck fails: settings UI uses fields missing from ScopedSettingsPatch
tasks.description:
`vp run typecheck` fails on `main` with 8 errors. They come from 46d050df14 (settings: login item, reasoning effort, settings backup and reset sections): the UI writes settings fields that the contracts do not define.

- `apps/web/src/components/settings/NotificationSettings.tsx`: `notificationQuietHoursStart`, `notificationQuietHoursEnd`, `notificationQuietHoursEnabled`, `usageWarningPercent`, `notificationVolume`
- `apps/web/src/components/settings/ReasoningEffortSettings.tsx`: `defaultReasoningEffort`

All are reported as unknown properties on `ScopedSettingsPatch` (`ServerSettingsPatch & ClientSettingsPatch`). The release build does not typecheck, so releases still ship, but these settings probably don't persist.

Fix: add the fields to the matching settings schemas and patches in `packages/contracts/src/settings.ts`, or remove the controls.

Found while pushing efb4a66cda; that push did not introduce them.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
